 The Best Skin Care Products of 2026, According to ELLE Editors 
 The Best Skin Care Products of 2026, According to ELLE Editors 
 We tried dozens of new launches to find our Future of Beauty award winners.
 By Kathleen Hou , Katie Berohn Published: Nov 9, 2026 Save Article Share Article Gerardo Huitrón // Getty Images Every item on this page was chosen by an ELLE editor. We may earn commission on some of the items you choose to buy. 
 1 min read New skin care products are everywhere—the minute you’ve finished trying the latest serum or eye cream, four more just like it seem to pop up in its place. That’s why we enlisted dozens of testers to find the best of this year’s skin care launches. We narrowed down 320 submissions to the 90 most innovative to test—and after vigorously trialing, we can confidently recommend 28, including a cream that helps extend the effects of Botox, a foamy serum packed with exosomes, and a liquid pimple patch. Keep reading for the game-changing Future of Beauty award winners worth adding to your skin care routine.
 Best Eye Serum Bloomeffects Black Tulip RegeneLift Eye Serum
 $49 at Ulta Beauty This eye serum may be lightweight, but thanks to ingredients like peptides and bakuchiol, our tester said it instantly smooths and hydrates, leaving the eye area brighter and more lifted. “My favorite part is the metal applicator. It feels cool on the skin, which is perfect for tired mornings,” she said. Another tester loved the milky texture, noting that it absorbed quickly without pilling under makeup.
 Best Rejuvenating Serum Dr. Dennis Gross DRx BioRejuvenation Serum
 $89 at Sephora Credit: Dennis Gross Powered by a precise ratio of amino acids commonly found in collagen, this serum is designed to help firm, tighten, and visibly lift. Our tester applied the serum around her mouth and noticed that area looked progressively smoother over time. She said the silky texture and pleasant scent were an added bonus, making the twice-daily ritual feel a little more indulgent.
 Best Lip Serum Dr. Diamond’s Metacine Liplift Hyaluron Peptide-6 BioFill Lip Treatment
 Shop at Amazon $120 at Revolve Credit: Dr. Diamond's Metacine Inspired by the in-office treatments that made Jason Diamond, MD, a favorite among A-listers like Kim Kardashian and Katy Perry, this lifting serum is designed to deliver fuller, smoother lips without the sting of traditional lip plumpers. The peptide-powered formula helps hydrate, soften fine lines, and enhance definition. Our tester said, “It has a lightweight, silky texture that makes it easy to wear on its own or layered over lip color.”
 Best Lip Balm Dr.Reju-All Advanced PDRN Rejuvenating Lip Serum
 $14 at Ulta Beauty Your answer to kissably soft, smooth, and supple lips arrives in this rich formula that looks like a gloss, with ingredients that read like your favorite facial serum: skin-barrier-strengthening PDRN, plus lactic acid and hibiscus enzymes for gentle exfoliation. “I love that the formula looks like a regular gloss, even though it’s repairing and soothing my lips underneath the sheen,” our tester shared.
 Best Rejuvenating Moisturizer Exoceuticals Exo Elevate Skin Longevity Complex Moisturizing Cream
 $169 at exoceuticals.com Credit: Exoceuticals Instead of a surplus of single-purpose formulas, what your skin needs is a moisturizer that treats everything effectively. Here it is: a formula that combines exosomes, peptides, fatty acids, and more to restore, strengthen, and balance skin. Our tester said: “After a week of using this, I started to really notice an improvement in some of my lines and the overall firmness of my skin. I definitely haven’t used a moisturizer before that had so many active ingredients.”
 Best Cleansing Balm Fresh Soy Cleansing Jelly Balm
 $42 at Ulta Beauty $42 at Nordstrom $42 at Sephora Expanding its Soy Cleansing empire, Fresh’s new balm has a texture that starts as jelly, becomes an oil, and then liquefies as you rinse it off. Soy protein is the star ingredient, adding moisture and boosting elasticity. Our tester felt that “the jelly did a great job of cleansing and removing my foundation while leaving it feeling clean and fresh, but not dry.” She also liked the tub format, noting, “I use a lot of facial cleansing oils, and this format felt innovative and easy to transport, which is not always the case with oils.”
 Best NAD+ Cream Goop Youth-Boost NAD+ Peptide Rich Cream
 $105 at Amazon $105 at Ulta Beauty $105 at Revolve “Gwyneth, I was not familiar with your game!” our tester raved. “Before testing this product, I read that it would lessen the appearance of my fine lines within a month. I was skeptical, but it really works!” This cream contains plant peptides and a precursor to NAD+, a powerful coenzyme that many celebrities use to biohack , as it purportedly helps stimulate mitochondria. “I have tried so many face creams over the years, but this is the only cream I think has actually made a difference.”
 Best Firming Eye Treatment Is Clinical GeneXC Firming Eye Gel
 $130 at Amazon $130 at isclinical.com “My under-eyes looked about 20 percent brighter as a result of using the product,” enthused our tester after just a week of consistent use. The silver applicator dispenses one cool dose of two different types of vitamin C and hyaluronic acid to smooth, moisturize, and deliver radiance to the under-eye area.
 Best Hyaluronic Acid Cream La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 Suractivated Rich Cream Jar
 Now 30% Off $40 $28 at Amazon $28 at Target $40 at Ulta Beauty “Replumping” power is one of the most intriguing aspects of this moisturizer. In a study of GLP-1 users who used both this cream and its sister serum, they reported smoother and more radiant skin, perhaps thanks to the combination of multiple hyaluronic acids and ectoin, an ingredient that prevents water loss. Our tester said, “I liked using this cream first thing in the morning. It absorbs right away and provides quick moisture, which I found worked well under makeup.”
 Best Serum Patch Ma:nyo Glutathione 7 Serum Patch
 $22 at Ulta Beauty $22 at Nordstrom Going beyond an under-eye or even a pimple patch, this is a patch—shaped like clouds, hearts, or stars, natch—that can go anywhere on your face to hydrate and reduce dark spots using glutathione and niacinamide. Our tester said, “My under-eyes are slightly less dark. But I enjoyed the cooling effect of these more than anything.”
 Best Face Balm Marie Veronique Senolytic Balm
 $185 at marieveronique.com People sometimes associate luxe face balms with granola-ish or sensuous formulations, rather than real science. But this one corrals powerful ingredients like vitamin C, resveratrol, and fisetin, a flavonoid that recent studies have shown can help clear out aged or dormant fibroblasts. “I really liked the product. I expected it to seize up or react strangely with my melange of other products, but in fact it seemed to lock them in to help them better absorb. It actually made my already oil-slicked skin feel less greasy. The next day, my naturally dry skin felt and looked hydrated.”
 Best Exosome Serum Medik8 Exo-PDRN Prismatic+ Vegan PDRN Serum With Triple Exosome Complex
 $96 at Sephora Credit: Medik8 PDRN and exosome treatments are both popular in Korea, and this serum is a vegan-friendly version of them, aimed at helping rejuvenate and moisturize skin. “I got a lot of sun over the summer, and this has helped bring my skin back to life! It has made it plumper and super hydrated,” our tester said.
 Best Pimple Treatment Hero Cosmetics Mighty Shield
 $15 at Amazon $15 at Target $15 at Ulta Beauty For those who prefer their pimple patches on the subtle side, the reigning patch brand has developed a new invisible bandage. Our tester is a frequent pimple patch wearer and liked that this clear version discouraged skin picking and sealed out bacteria, so that her zits could flatten in just a few hours.
 Best Neck Treatment Olay Regenerist Lifting and Sculpting Face and Neck Treatment
 $35 at Walmart A face sculptor and moisturizer in one, this rollerball dispenses a mix of collagen peptides and NAD+. The cooling applicator allows you to glide it across your neck, décolletage, and the lymph nodes for a sculpting effect. “I primarily used this on my neck and jawline and areas I don’t pay enough attention to. My skin looked plumper and smoother after use,” our tester said.
 Best De-Puffing Mask Rhode Caffeine Reset
 $38 at rhodeskin.com Credit: Rhode Like a shot of espresso for your face, this tingling cream mask has caffeine to depuff and peptides to add radiance. “The Caffeine Reset definitely feels like an elevated addition to my routine,” said our tester. “The formula felt cooling and comfortable on my sensitive skin, and I loved the packaging. The depuffing results weren’t dramatic for me, but I loved how it felt and think it’s the kind of product I’d especially reach for after a late night or early morning.”
 Best Adaptive Sunscreen Octo Skin Care Performance SPF40
 $50 at octoskincare.com Credit: Octo This botanical-infused mineral sunscreen has an SPF-plus formula that visibly calms redness while protecting the skin. Our tester did want to flag that this is a capital-M mineral sunscreen, meaning that it has a thicker texture and requires a bit of rubbing. But it’s worth it, she said, because it provides sun protection that lasts longer than the formulas she usually uses.
 Best Mineral Sunscreen Ilia Sun Serum Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50
 $40 at Amazon $40 at Ulta Beauty $40 at Nordstrom Is it possible for a sunscreen to make you look glowy without being greasy? As it turns out, yes. This one comes in two shades and has a natural finish. Every swipe of this hydrating sunscreen gives skin a cast-free finish and has a water-burst-like texture, according to our tester, who loved how moisturizing it felt.
 Best Rejuvenating Moisturizer Dior Prestige La Crème Texture Essentielle
 $495 at Dior Credit: Dior A combination of powerful, rare botanicals and a new “micro-filler” technology makes this cream especially luxurious. It contains peptides from Dior’s proprietary Rose de Granville, a hardy, resilient variety grown on the French cliffs. The brand’s micro-filler technology also glosses over texture and fine lines so that skin looks extra smooth. “Putting this on my chest made a weird shoulder crinkle disappear, so I can only imagine the possibilities that it could have for my face,” our tester said.
 Best Brightening Eye Treatment Upneeq Reveal Under Eye Complex
 $75 at upneeq.com Credit: Upneeq You may know Upneeq for its prescription eye drops that help open low-lying lids. Now, it has also made an over-the-counter eye cream to firm and brighten with vitamin C and peptides (though it does not help your eyes appear more open). “I love the way this cream feels going on,” our tester raved. “It’s so smooth, like butter, and absorbs easily.”
 Best Firming Moisturizer Skinceuticals P-TIOX Anti-Wrinkle Cream
 $150 at SkinCeuticals Credit: Skinceuticals Our tester couldn’t stop marveling at how good her skin looked after using this cream. “It’s smooth and firmer, and I really see fewer fine lines. But my favorite thing about this cream is the way it melts in—I feel like I am taking a watering can to my face.” The formula is intensely hydrating, but its real breakthrough is that it’s made with Myrixin, a flavonoid complex with six different plant extracts that boasts Botox-like effects and helps smooth deep-set wrinkles.
 Best Exosome Booster Skorr Skin care Skin Revive Exosome EGF Booster
 $285 at skorrskin.com Credit: Skorr Our tester didn’t really “believe” in serums. But this one, packed with lab-synthesized exosomes and growth factor technology, changed her mind. She said, “My skin immediately felt more plump, smooth, and visibly firm the first time I used it. I just looked in the mirror and thought to myself, Ooooh, my skin looks good! It had been a bit stressed from this summer’s erratic weather, and this serum seems to have not only repaired but erased some of that damage. It’s simply made my skin look so much better than it has in a while.”
 Best Tanning Mask MSK Labs The Night Affair Overnight Tanning Mask
 $40 at Moda Operandi Credit: MSK Labs Self-tanning meets skin care with this mask that combines a low level of DHA with erythrulose, a sugar that creates a sunless tanning effect, along with powerhouse ingredients like hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, lactic acid, and more. The combination had our tester marveling over the subtlety of the results. “It didn’t transfer on my pillow or make me look orange, and I woke up looking like I had freshly applied bronzer.”
 Best Skin-Plumping Serum SeneGence GLP-Complex with SenePlex+ and Exosomes
 $155 at senegence.com Credit: Senegence Don’t confuse this serum with a GLP-1—our tester found it to be the exact opposite. “Immediate plumping effects,” she said. “My cheeks were noticeably bouncier and had more volume.” Formulated with peptides, lipids, and plant-based exosomes, it’s an all-in-one serum that helps to protect, moisturize, and boost hydration. “I tried this along with several other serums and found it was the one I constantly gravitated toward. The feel is so hydrating and velvety, and it has a light, fairly neutral, non-medicinal smell.”
 Best K-Beauty Serum Biodance Caviar PDRN Liposome Bubble Booster
 Now 13% Off $23 $20 at Amazon Credit: Biodance Feel like you’re moisturizing with champagne using this serum, which dispenses a hydrating essence with a unique, foamy effervescence. Unlike real champagne, it’s not sticky or drying; the bubbles are thanks to liposomes containing peptides and ceramides. Our tester said, “This is the kind of product that encapsulates modern K-beauty. The bubbly foam format was so fun, and my skin was moisturized too, with a softness that lasted all day.”
 Best Renewing Moisturizer Lancôme Absolue Longevity MD Reset Face Cream
 $155 at Ulta Beauty Credit: Lancôme The brand partnered with Timeline, a longevity supplement brand, to create one of the first skin care ranges using Mitopure, a postbiotic that is alleged to trigger mitochondrial renewal. Our tester said that this cream felt supremely luxurious. “It was creamy and silky and had a faint, ‘fancy skin care’ scent. In the morning, I had soft, hydrated skin.”
 Best High-Tech Sunscreen Neutrogena Clear Face Sunscreen for Acne-Prone Skin Broad Spectrum SPF 60 with BEMT
 $17 at Amazon $20 at Ulta Beauty Credit: Neutrogena This is one of the first U.S. sunscreens to contain BEMT, the first new SPF ingredient approved by the FDA in more than two decades, and our tester noticed the innovation immediately. “I liked that the consistency is quite thin and isn’t sticky—that’s my favorite for an under-the-makeup sunscreen. It was very easy to apply too.”
 Best Sunscreen for Reapplication Sulwhasoo UV Wise On-the-Go Sun Cushion SPF 50+
 $45 at Macy's $45 at Sephora Credit: Sulwhasoo Cushion compacts, a format that K-beauty often uses for foundation, are now getting the sunscreen treatment. In contrast to cream formats, the compact hides a broad-spectrum SPF 50 that you apply with a few taps of the cushion. Our tester loved the blendability of this formula and said the compact allowed for touch-ups throughout the day. “It was so moisturizing, and so much more efficient and less messy to apply SPF this way.”
 Best Sculpting Serum Shiseido Vital Perfection Intensive SculptDefine Serum
 $155 at Amazon $155 at Ulta Beauty $155 at Macy's Scientists at Shiseido created the D-AminoLift Complex, a new blend of amino acids that bolster collagen. With watercress to boost radiance and reduce sallowness, plus niacinamide and safflower red to help address oxidative stress, the serum is designed to plump and sculpt at the same time. Our tester said, “This texture has a velvety feel. It left my skin feeling renewed, moisturized, and really, really soft.”
